text: Subject : Dispute of Unauthorized Credit Inquiries Dear Experian I am writing to formally dispute unauthorized inquiries on my credit report. I recently obtained a copy of my credit report and discovered inquiries that I did not authorize. These inquiries may be the result of identity theft or a clerical error, and I am concerned about their potential impact on my credit score. The details of the unauthorized inquiries are as follows : 9inquiries These lenders have accessed your credit file : XXXX Inquiry date XX/XX/XXXXXXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX Inquiry date XX/XX/XXXXXXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX Inquiry date XX/XX/XXXXXXXX XXXX XXXX Inquiry date XX/XX/XXXX XXXX XXXX Inquiry date XX/XX/XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX Inquiry date XX/XX/XXXX XXXX XXXX Inquiry date XX/XX/XXXXXXXX XXXX XXXX XXXXXXXX XXXX XXXX XX/XX/XXXX XXXX XXXX Inquiry date XX/XX/XXXX I have no knowledge of these companies nor have I authorized them to access my credit report. According to the Fair Credit Reporting Act, I have the right to challenge inaccurate or unauthorized items on my credit report. To resolve this matter, I kindly request that you : Investigate these inquiries to determine their origin and legitimacy. Remove these unauthorized inquiries from my credit report if they are found to be erroneous or fraudulent. Provide me with an updated copy of my credit report post-investigation. For your reference, I have attached copies of my credit report highlighting the disputed inquiries, as well as any relevant supporting documents. I appreciate your prompt attention to this matter and expect a response within 30 days, as stipulated by federal law. Please contact me if you require any additional information or clarification. Thank you for your cooperation and assistance in resolving this issue. Sincerely, XXXX XXXX
